verses.gurmukhi: ਲਸਣੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਲੁਕੈ ਬਹਿ ਖਾਜੈ ਕੂਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: lasan lukaiaa naa lukai beh khaajai koonai|

en.bdb: The smell of garlic cannot be concealed even if it is eaten in a remote corner.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲਾ ਕੰਬਲੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਕਿਉਂ ਹੋਇ ਸਬੂਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: kaalaa ka(n)bal ujalaa kiau(n) hoi saboonai|

en.bdb: No soap how so much applied, can turn the black blanket into white.

verses.gurmukhi: ਡੇਮੂ ਖਖਰ ਜੋ ਛੁਹੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਸੂਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: ddemoo khakhar jo chhuhai dhisai muh soonai|

en.bdb: Whosoever will touch the hive of poisonous wasps will find his face swollen.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਨਾ ਆਵਈ ਲਾਵਣੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਲੂਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: kitai ka(n)m naa aaviee laavan bin loonai|

en.bdb: The cooked vegetable devoid of salt is absolutely useless.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਵਿਹੂਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: ni(n)dhak naam visaariaa gur giaan vihoonai|

en.bdb: Without the knowledge of the true Guru, the backbiter has neglected the name of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾ ਲਹੈ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਸਿਰੁ ਝੂਣੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit_en: halat palat sukh naa lahai dhukheeaa sir jhoonai ||3||

en.bdb: He gets happiness neither here nor there and always laments and repents.
